page.overview:
What is Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Bake-danuki?

The Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Bake-danuki is a video game exclusive Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit. It allows the user to transform into a bake-danuki, a type of tanuki monster. It was "eaten" by a pen that became Pato.

The most basic strength of the fruit is that it gives its user the strengths and powers of a monster raccoon dog. In the case of Pato, the fruit's most major strength is that it has given life to an otherwise inanimate object. An object that has been given life by this fruit will also have sapient intelligence and the ability to speak, likely due to being a monster raccoon dog rather than a regular one.

Being a Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit, it gives the user the specific traits of the mythical raccoon dog in which it can transform ordinary leaves into anything else, from objects to other people and entire environments. In Pato's case, he must write a name on the leaf with his pen-tail for it to transform. The individuals the user creates have the same exact abilities, skills, personality, and memories as the originals and are utterly loyal to the user. They can even create copies of themselves.

The strength of the people that the user creates varies between each clone, what determines how strong they are is unknown, however. For example, the real Straw Hat Pirates easily defeated an army of clones which included themselves and several powerful enemies that they've faced in the past, such as Akainu, Crocodile, Enel, and others. On the other hand, clones the likes of Rob Lucci, Hody, and Wapol required the Straw Hat's to spend considerable effort to defeat each of them despite the crew being significantly stronger than the originals. Also, if another person uses the abilities of the user against their will, then the clones will become loyal to them instead of the user. In addition, sometimes the clones will end up betraying their creator for various reasons, such as when Ace turned against Red after fighting with Luffy. Other than that, the user is also affected by the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.
